biggest_catch: You must agree to Stripe Connect terms AND have one successful weekly payout before Instant Payout unlocks — your first week of work can't be cashed out same-day.
catches: Instant Payout only unlocks after your first successful weekly Friday direct deposit.
Uncashed funds roll into the weekly direct deposit automatically at Sunday 11:59pm CT.
Taxes are not withheld — set aside ~20-30% for self-employment tax.
Gas, data, and vehicle costs are yours.
Eligibility is metro-dependent; some areas have shopper waitlists.

c1.evidence: Official Shipt help (help.shipt.com): 'Shoppers with Shipt are independent contractors and are paid per order.'

c2.evidence: Official Shipt: 'Orders will be offered with an estimated pay based on the time and effort it takes to complete the order.' Every order shows its estimated pay before you accept.

c3.evidence: Official Shipt: 'There is no cost to sign up to become a shopper with Shipt.'

c4.evidence: Official Shipt: 'Pay for completed orders can be accessed instantly 3 times per day* or received via direct deposit every Friday... This will include pay for orders and 100% of any tips received.' Same-day cashout confirmed.

eligibility: 18+; reliable transportation; background check; metro-dependent availability.
notes: Checked 2026-09-23. Official evidence from help.shipt.com + shoppers.shipt.com. Payout amounts are per-order estimates (concrete per offer at acceptance), not a fixed rate. Distinct from Instacart.
numeric_basis: payout: per-order estimated pay + 100% tips shown before accepting (official, varies); time: per order 20-60 min
payout_quote: Shoppers with Shipt are independent contractors and are paid per order. Orders will be offered with an estimated pay based on the time and effort it takes to complete the order. (help.shipt.com) | Pay for completed orders can be accessed instantly 3 times per day* or received via direct deposit every Friday for the work completed the previous Monday through Sunday. (help.shipt.com)
payout_value_note: per-order estimated pay + 100% tips (varies; shown before accepting)
steps: Sign up as a Shipt shopper (transport, background check, metro availability).
Claim orders in the shopper app; each order card shows estimated pay.
Shop and deliver within the requested window; receive 100% of tips.
Once eligible (Stripe Connect terms + one weekly payout), use Instant Payout up to 3x/day.
Funds transfer on demand to your account; anything uncashed deposits Friday.
timing: Instant Payout up to 3x/day on demand once eligible (needs 1 weekly payout first). Weekly direct deposit on Fridays for Mon–Sun work.
who_pays: Shipt pays you per completed order — each order is offered with an estimated pay based on the time and effort it takes.
who_qualifies: 18+; reliable transportation; a background check; in Shipt metro areas (some areas have shopper waitlists).
work_available: Metro-dependent — some areas have shopper waitlists, so you may not be able to start right away even if your city is listed. Orders appear in the app once you're approved.
what_gets_accepted: Complete the order as offered. Taxes are not withheld — set aside roughly 20–30% for self-employment tax.
costs_and_unpaid_time: No fees. Unpaid time: waiting between orders; gas, data, and vehicle costs are yours.
when_cash_arrives: Instant Payout up to 3 times a day on demand once eligible (you need one successful weekly payout first). Otherwise, free weekly direct deposit on Fridays for Monday–Sunday work.

repeatable.cadence: Shop batches whenever you want — each batch earns, cash out up to 3x a day with Instant Payout, and keep shopping.
